new_assertions.body: Component-width exchange W is nonessential in the declared common scalar carrier: C+D0+D1 is exact under both SIGN and SIGNED_PARITY on all three hard carriers.
4x5-k4 makes C, D0, and D1 individually load-bearing within the frozen family lattice because every strict subset of C+D0+D1 is scalar-inexact there.
Capacity phase is a cross-carrier rather than per-carrier necessity: horizontal-only 6x3-k4 is exact with D0+D1 alone, but 4x5-k4 requires C in the common support.
6x3-k3 has incomparable minimal supports C+D1 and D0+D1; therefore one-carrier MSS structure does not determine the common transfer support.
The next lawful compression axis is internal token identity: exact capacity-role indices C:i and exact owner-depth indices D0:d/D1:d, with family membership C/D0/D1 held fixed.
EW-RS-059 remains sealed because family MSS does not freeze a closed scalar syndrome.
